--backend-config.help: Configuration file (YAML format) containing options to pass to the backend

--backend-option.help: Options and switches that are passed to the backend

--config.help: Configurations with field name and index mapping for target environment. Multiple configurations are merged into one. Last config is authoritative in case of conflicts.

--converted-list.help: Write list of rule files that were successfully converted (default: stdout)

--defer-abort.help: Don't abort on parse or conversion errors, proceed with next rule. The exit code from the last error is returned

--email.help: email address to send mail alert

--error.help: Exit with error code 10 on verification failures.

--event.help: Add Sigma rule to event with this ID. If not set, create new event.

--filter.help:
Define comma-separated filters that must match (AND-linked) to rule to be processed.
    Valid filters: level<=x, level>=x, level=x, status=y, logsource=z, tag=t, target=o.
    x is one of: low, medium, high, critical.
    y is one of: experimental, testing, stable.
    z is a word appearing in an arbitrary log source attribute.
    t is a tag that must appear in the rules tag list, case-insensitive matching.
    o is a target that must appear in the rules target list, case-insensitive matching.
    Multiple log source specifications are AND linked.
    Special filter:
    inlastday=X rule create or modified in the last X days period
    tlp=valid_tlp if rule have no tlp set to WHITE

--help.help: show this help message and exit

--ignore-backend-errors.help: Only return error codes for parse errors and ignore errors for rules that cause backend errors. Useful, when you want to get as much queries as possible.

--ignore-not-implemented.help: Only return error codes for parse errors and ignore

--info.help: Event Information field for newly created MISP event.

--lists.help: List available output target formats and configurations

--lists-files-after-date.help: List yml files  which is modified/created after the date (Example of the date: 2022/02/01).

--min-similarity.help: Only output pairs with a similarity above this threshold (percent)

--no-comment.help: Don't store rule names in comments

--oneline.help: Put all tags on a single line

--out-file.help: File to write the JSON layer to

--outdir.help: output directory to create elastalert rules

--output.help: Output file or directory. Default: standard output.

--output-extention.help: Extension of Output file for filename prefix use

--output-fields.help:
Enhance your output with additional fields from the Sigma rule (not only the converted rule itself).
    Select the fields you want by providing their list delimited with commas (no space). Only work with the '--output-format' option and with 'json' or 'yaml' value.
    available additional fields : title, id, status, description, author, references, fields, falsepositives, level, tags.
    This option do not have any effect for backends that already format output : elastalert, kibana, splukxml etc.

--output-format.help: Use only if you want to have JSON or YAML output (default is raw text)

--primary.help: File with list of paths to primary rules. If given, only rule combinations with at least one primary rule are compared. Primary rules must also be contained in input rule set.

--recurse.help: Use directory as input (recurse into subdirectories is not implemented yet)

--ruledir.help: sigma rule directory path to convert

--same-event.help: Import all Sigma rules to the same event, if no event is set.

--top.help: Only output the n most similar rule pairs.

--verbose.help: Be verbose. Use once more for debug output.

--verify.help: Verify existence and uniqueness of UUID assignments. Exits with error code if verification fails.

sigma.help: Sigma rule file(s) that should be converted
